description: The Department of Education at the University of Vermont was organized around the premise that education study should serve teachers of other subjects rather than stand as an isolated elective.
title: University of Vermont Department of Education organized so education strengthens teaching of other subjects

description: The program's requirements interleave education study with subject-matter study across the degree.
title: Vermont education program pattern combining education courses, two outside subjects, secondary methods, and an educational thesis

description: At the master's level, the department pairs education study with disciplinary specialization.
title: Master's pattern splitting study between education and a specialization, with the thesis discussed in light of educational principles
